slides.title: Executive Spend & Portfolio Concentration
slides.headline: Total IT Spend ₹161.83 Cr concentrated across 50 applications.
bullets: Top 3 systems (CoreBanking Alpha, Legacy Customer Web Portal, Cloud Payment Microhub) account for 29.2% of total spend.
Top 10 systems consume 58% of software & cloud infrastructure capital.

slides.title: FinOps Cost Variance & Root-Cause Signals
slides.headline: August spend shift of ₹+0.98 Cr decomposed into elastic scale vs rate anomaly.
bullets: APP014 (Cloud Payment Hub) surge correlated with +180% transaction volume expansion.
APP022 (Batch Billing) surged +₹38L with flat transaction throughput (investigation alert filed).

slides.title: Business Capability Unit Economics
slides.headline: Full-stack proportional capability attribution with zero reconciliation leakage.
bullets: Order-to-Cash (CAP003) and Core Account Servicing (CAP001) drive 35% of total capability costs.
Scale anchors achieve sub-₹0.05 per business transaction.

slides.title: Portfolio Rationalization & Topological Gating
slides.headline: Elimination candidates identified alongside critical Single Points of Failure.
bullets: APP021 identified as prime rationalization review candidate with ₹8.4 Cr avoidable run-rate baseline.
APP010 (Central Auth Hub) flagged as critical topological bottleneck (8 direct downstream systems).

slides.title: Investment Value Realization & Governance Actions
slides.headline: High-performing PRJ003 (+108% BRR) contrasted with PRJ014 benefit deficit.
bullets: PRJ003 exceeded expected benefit returns (₹20.7 Cr realized vs ₹19.2 Cr target).
PRJ014 delivered only 23% of planned CRM transformation value (₹23 Cr benefit deficit).
Recommendation: Approve capital rebalancing from legacy maintenance to strategic cloud capabilities.
